# Official challenge scorer (reference copy)

`score.py` is an unmodified copy of `scoring/score.py` from
[MIT-CAVE/rc-cli](https://github.com/MIT-CAVE/rc-cli), the command-line tool of the
2021 Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge. It is distributed under the MIT
licence in `LICENSE` (Copyright (c) 2021 MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics).

It is kept only so that `tests/test_scoring.py` can verify that the project's own
scorer (`src/lastmile/scoring.py`) produces the same results.
